programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: On Talking Business BBC presenters, based in the world's most dynamic cities, discuss with the most important and influential people from the world of business and finance, the key issues of the day. Corporate leaders, global investors, top creatives, cutting-edge entrepreneurs and leading intellectuals gather together weekly to discuss and analyse the issues and trends that most affect how business has to work in today's world. Our team of presenters are experts on the issues and developments which are shaping the way we work, consume and live in the 21st Century.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. programme.title: China's Greatest Treasures
programme.desc: Compelling documentary series in which host, BBC Art Critic Alastair Sooke, embarks on an adventure of a lifetime, travelling through modern day China to examine how China's most important historic artefacts housed in museum collections across the country still influence and define the nation today. Subjects covered in the series include family and ancestors, calligraphy, food, technology, China's links with the rest of the world, and much more.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Welcome to the Patrick Star Show hosted by Patrick himself and revolving around his extraordinary family and his own bizzare fantasies. Get to know his family, his Dad Cecil Star, his Mom Bunny Star, his sister Squidina Star, and GrandPat Star, and find out where his charm and eccentricity come from.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Takes us on a roller coaster ride of music, laughter and stories geared to entertain The Chipmunks' four generations of fans. Presented for the first time in glorious CGI, the series features ground-breaking animation and a new, original Chipmunk song in every episode. The series is an animated version of a prime-time sitcom and reflects the trials and tribulations of a single parent, David Seville, trying to raise six hyper-active Chipmunks. Like most parents, Dave's patience will be pushed to the limit, forcing him to end most sentences in "ALVINNN!!!"

programme.title: White Dog
programme.desc: At a time when the country was exploding after the assassination of Martin Luther King, the writer Romain Gary, a humanist and animal lover, and his wife, the star Jean Seberg, a civil rights activist, took in an abandoned dog.

programme.title: Savage Salvation
programme.desc: A recovering opioid addict seeks revenge on the dealers responsible for selling the drugs that resulted in his fiancee's death.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: The lucky winner of the national lottery is Ned Devine, so taken by his good fortune that he now can't be waked, because he died from the shock of it! News of the win spread quickly in the scenic little Irish village of Tully More, but not the secret news of Ned's demise. With lottery officials closing in to confirm the prize claimed by the deceased Devine, Ned's closest friends scheme to keep the prize money close to home, in memory of Ned of course! But as the plot twists humorously, they learn it is hard is to keep such a secret in a small town.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: Old-fashioned
programme.desc: One island, 40 inhabitants, two scammers. On a picturesque island in Brittany, lifelong friends Jean-Jean (Didier Bourdon) and Henri (Gérard Darmon, Employee of the Month) find their quiet existence disrupted when one of their fellow villagers wins millions in the national lottery. The pair hatch a plan to befriend the lucky local and hopefully share in the winnings... only to find the winner has died of shock - ticket in hand! Jean-Jean and Henri must devise another scheme. In order to claim the prize, the friends will simply steal the unlucky winner's identity... However, the pair soon realise that to fool the lottery officials in such a small town, they'll have to convince the villagers - who all want a piece of the pie - to back their daring plan. Jean-Jean and Henri are out to prove that you're never too old to raise a little hell in this crowd-pleasing comedy, a remake of the Irish classic Waking Ned Devine. With a winning blend of absurdity and heart, you'll fall in love with the stunning sights of Brittany and its colourful characters. This charming story shows what a community can achieve when they come together (yes, even fraud).

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere.

programme.title: Thunderpants
programme.desc: An 11-year-old boy's amazing ability to break wind leads him first to fame and then to death row before it helps him to fulfil his ambition of becoming an astronaut.

programme.title: Ramen Shop
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients.

programme.title: The Green Perfume
programme.desc: Crime - Comedy, Premiere. After witnessing a murder on stage, an actor is drawn into a thrilling investigation across Europe, uncovering secrets and hidden conspiracies that challenge his perception of reality. (Sandrine Kiberlain, Arieh Worthalter) 2022, 101'

programme.title: God Help the Girl
programme.desc: Emily Browning, Olly Alexander, Hannah Murray and Pierre Boulanger star in first-time screenwriter-director Stuart Murdoch's romantic musical. Murdoch is lead singer and songwriter of Scottish band Belle and Sebastian, and this movie sprang from his side-project album showcasing songs about and sung by women. Browning plays (and sings) the lead role of Eve, an aspiring singer and musician who struggles with an eating disorder and depression. Attending a gig in Glasgow, Eve meets nerdy singer-songwriter James (Alexander), who works as a university lifeguard and teaches guitar. When she gets stranded in the city, he puts her up for the night and the two strike up a friendship that promises romance. They form a band with Cassie (Murray), one of James's guitar students, and together they strive to achieve their dream of stardom. But Eve's friendship with Anton (Boulanger), the frontman of up-and-coming band Wobbly-Legged Rat will cause a series of problems. With Mark Radcliffe, Stuart Maconie and Josie Long.

programme.title: Hey, Viktor!
programme.desc: 25 long years after his time in the limelight, a former child actor tries to revive his fortunes with a self-produced sequel.

programme.title: She's Lost Control
programme.desc: While studying for her master's degree, Ronah works as sexual surrogate in New York City under therapist Dr. Alan Cassidy. Cassidy refers to her a new client, Johnny, a man with intimacy issues. On their first appointment, Johnny drinks alcohol, which Ronah discourages, though she says he can discuss the matter with Cassidy. Johnny's hostility to Ronah's attempts to get him to open up eventually leads him to reveal in one session that he does not trust her and desires to strangle her. In her progress reports with Cassidy, Ronah confirms her desire to continue working with him, as she does not want to give up on him. Johnny continues to drink during their sessions, citing a guideline from Cassidy that one drink before their session is fine.

programme.title: The Disobedient
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Life at Vet University
programme.desc: Documentary series following six students at the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine, as they prepare to complete their gruelling four-year education at one of the most prestigious veterinarian colleges in the world. Known as Penn Vet, the institute is recognised as one of the most distinguished schools in animal research and care, and the course requires the students' full devotion if they wish to graduate as veterinarians. Watch the students as they meander their perpetual studies and put their learning into practice, growing both as people and professionals during the intense, consuming course.

Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees

Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Using their Sourthern charm and engineering knowledge to create supernatural inventions during their hunting to find ghosts or spirits of any kind. Their speciality is investigating the decaying, haunting and skin crawling mental institutions throughout the USA, warning viewers that they have permission to enter the most haunted buildings and that chasing ghosts without proper training "will get you killed", so don't try this at home.

programme.title: Alaska Monsters

programme.title: Ghost Loop
programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Lost Monster Files
programme.desc: The team investigates a rash of recent Abominable Snowman encounters in the wilderness of British Columbia using research from Ivan Sanderson's lost archive. When the team debates whether it's actually the elusive creature or a rare bear species, they uncover new evidence that may finally distinguish fact from fiction.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Virgins
programme.desc: After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad
programme.desc: After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

programme.title: 90 Day: The Single Life Pillow Talk
programme.desc: Series favourites give their own juicy opinions on the previous episode's drama. From the comfort of their home, no one is holding back!

programme.title: Dr. Mercy
programme.desc: Get to know Dr. Mercy, the doctor who is changing patients' lives for the better thanks to her deep knowledge and passion. Dr. Mercy takes care of the most bizarre skin cases and makes her patients feel better and healthier not only outside but inside. She tackles giant cysts, rare skin disorders, extreme moles, unwanted female facial hair, acne and what not.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: How are winters getting worse when the earth is getting warmer? The warming planet is heating more rapidly in the north, heating up the mass of arctic air called the Polar Vortex. A warmer Polar Vortex is in turn weakening the jet stream which normally serves to contain the arctic air. But now, the wobbly jet stream is allowing frigid arctic temperatures to travel south bringing with it things like nor'easters, epic blizzards, bomb cyclones and frost quakes. This episode follows the stories of storm chasers caught in blizzards, farmers livelihoods compromised by extreme cold and snow, as well as the consequences of cold on our infrastructure..

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Mutant Weather takes viewers onto the front line of the shocking new weather phenomena that, thanks to climate change, are changing the world around us faster than we can keep up: terrifying elemental events with names like Dry Lightning, Thundersnow, Polar Vortexes, Firenadoes, Ice Waves and Atmospheric Rivers. Mutant Weather tells the stories of these mutations, from gestation and birth to their cataclysmic impact and how they will evolve next, using spectacular video footage, first-hand testimonies from those who've experienced them, expert scientific analysis, stunning graphics and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on the task of restoring a 1974 Mk1 Ford Capri. Its owner, 53 year old Helen, is a lifelong petrol head who bought her dream car nearly 8 years ago with the plan to strip it down and do full nut and bolt rebuild. However after a terrible accident Helen was left with heart problems and in constant pain from severe rheumatoid arthritis the restoration of her Capri was put on hold. Daughter Rebecca and son Rob called Car SOS help put their mother's car back on the road and the gleam back in her eye.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have picked up a 1999 Subaru Impreza, a Japanese boy racer car that won titles on the rally tracks and the hearts of many adoring fans. Its two litre, boxer engine set it apart from its rivals. The car's owner Matt has loved Imprezas since he was a boy and bought his dream car 10 years ago as a restoration project but since developing a degenerative back condition which makes physical work almost impossible , his restoration ground to a halt. With Matt in constant pain and forced to give up his job as a carpenter his prized Subaru was put into a garage where it has sat, untouched, for the last few years. Now, Matt's family have contacted Car SOS asking for help in getting the Impreza on the road again.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on their smallest ever car and one of their biggest jobs, a 1958 Messerschmitt KR200 bubble car. The car's owner is 23 year old graphic designer Sam, he bought the car with his dad as a joint restoration project but when Sam was struck with a serious heart condition their plans were scuppered. Now, with Sam is still dealing with the consequences of his heart problems the Car SOS boys have stepped in to save this tiny Messerschmitt bubble car and help put a smile back on its owners face.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: The UK's engineering wonders revealed: including innovative electric flying machines, ingenious skyscrapers, the secrets of London's Tower Bridge, a 57 billion pound railway and a mega-stadium with a surprising historical twist.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Explore the engineering wonders of Europe's northernmost region, from Iceland's epic lava-defying barriers to Finland's record-breaking vertical factory. This spectacular journey uncovers the Nordic's boldest builds including the construction of the world's largest wooden city and a Swedish ferry that doesn't just sail—it flies.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Air and Marine Interdiction agents in Mayagüez intercept traffickers coming from the Dominican Republic with over $60 million in cocaine onboard. In Fajardo, agents investigate a boat suspected of smuggling cocaine from St. Thomas to Puerto Rico. In the U.S Virgin Islands, agents search for a sunken vessel believed to be carrying bulk cash from drug dealers.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: At the California border, CBP searches a suspicious bulletproof truck and stops an SUV loaded with over $200,000 worth of concealed methamphetamine. Atlanta CBP Rovers hunt for smuggled cash, uncovering over $100,000 in counterfeit hundred dollar bills. And AMO executes Operation Blood Moon in the skies and waters around Puerto Rico. A high speed chase leads the agents to a seizure of nearly 2000 kilos of cocaine worth over $72 million.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. A US citizen is caught with cocaine - and her story doesn't add up. A woman with cocaine in her suitcase comes clean and a police sting nets another suspect. A Japanese karaoke star is carrying more than music. A carrier implicates her mom. A false positive.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: On this episode, Antinarcotics officials at Jorge Chavez International Airport in Lima, Peru, face a potentially dramatic situation: a woman is arrested trying to smuggle cocaine while traveling with her two young children. Also, the detention of an elderly man reveals that drug cartels are looking for new carrier profiles. A young woman breaks down into tears when she is detained for what is apparently illegal trafficking, while a young man who was formerly imprisoned for drug trafficking in the United Arab Emirates raises the agents' suspicions, who decide to interrogate him.At the loading docks, a typical Peruvian handicraft turns out to be the package of a pilot drug shipment, and a Chinese citizen who tried to evade security controls to traffic maca bulbs must face the consequences of his actions.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report

programme.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time
programme.desc: A massive earthquake in the Indian Ocean sets off a tsunami that, within minutes, arrives in the bustling city of Aceh, causing unprecedented havoc and devastation. This film follows the desperate struggle to survive of city-dwellers in Indonesia and tourists in Thailand caught in the unfolding catastrophe, as well as the scientists working against the clock to warn the world.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: At 1.23AM on April 26th,1986 a massive explosion rips through reactor number four at Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Soviet Ukraine. A safety test has triggered the worst nuclear accident in history, releasing 400 times more radiation into the atmosphere than the Hiroshima bomb. While control room operators reel in shock, the nuclear plant's firefighters battle the blaze amidst lethal levels of radiation. Just 3km away in the local town of Pripyat, Communist party officials encourage life to go on as normal. Children go to school and couples get married while radiation rains down on them. Meanwhile a giant radioactive cloud starts to circle the globe. Episode 1 follows the first 24-hours of the disaster, with first-hand accounts from people desperately trying to make sense of an accident no one thought could ever happen.

programme.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programme.desc: It's a typically vibrant New Orleans summer when Hurricane Katrina looms. Sitting in the bullseye of a Category 5, the city faces a reality check. With a delayed evacuation order, many are trapped and forced to brace for the storm's fury. Residents recount for the first time how they navigated the impending disaster, capturing the harrowing experience of preparing for "The Big One."

programme.title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
programme.desc: April 19, 1995, begins like any other in Oklahoma City, until a bomb explodes outside a federal building. Oklahomans are plunged into chaos, and first responders race against the clock to save those trapped inside. Meanwhile, the media search for answers, and the FBI begins what will be their biggest investigation yet.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Jordan, archaeologists make a stunning find: a sealed tomb containing 12 undisturbed skeletons dating to the height of Nabataean civilization. Artifacts and symbolic design suggest the chamber may have been a royal or priestly burial, though its secrecy hints at tragedy. In Scotland, excavations beneath a 17th-century hunting lodge reveal a hoard of 36 buried coins. Likely concealed during the 1692 Glencoe massacre, the find ties to the MacDonald clan and centuries of conflict. In Peru, gas workers uncover two pre-Incan tombs, one occupied and one empty. The burials, attributed to the Chancay culture, raise questions about ritual, symbolism and loss. Finally, in England, a 4,000-year-old oak log coffin reveals a Bronze Age leader with a ceremonial axe on a bed of plants.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Italy, explorers uncover an immense tunnel system, revealing a vast subterranean world once thought to be catacombs or escape routes. Excavations show it was a self-contained infrastructure network. In Germany, construction workers uncover eight mass graves containing over 1,000 skeletons. Artifacts and records trace the site to the plague outbreak, when famine, siege and disease wiped out thousands. In London, archaeologists unearth the foundations of the city's earliest Roman basilica, built to symbolize imperial power. Demolished just decades later, the structure's rise and fall mirror the evolution of Londinium. In Denmark, Neolithic longhouses and a mysterious chamber reveal traces of early farming life. This site may have served as both a ceremonial center and a food storage system, offering a glimpse into Scandinavian society.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Seoul, South Korea, workers uncover a massive underground chamber hidden beneath the CitiStar Mall and the subway's Line 2. Experts debate its purpose. Was it a Cold War-era bunker, a secret intelligence facility, or simply a byproduct of subway construction? In Poland, excavations beneath a former ice cream shop reveal a medieval tomb marked by a knight carved in limestone. His identity remains unknown, but his burial illuminates the city's turbulent past under shifting dynasties and foreign rule. In England, demolition of the long-lost St. Mary's Church exposes Roman ruins below — three decapitated stone busts and a glass vessel buried in ritual fashion. Finally, in Los Angeles, scientists reexamine the Lincoln Heights whale, a 10-million-year-old fossil from a previously unknown species.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. A US citizen is caught with cocaine - and her story doesn't add up. A woman with cocaine in her suitcase comes clean and a police sting nets another suspect. A Japanese karaoke star is carrying more than music. A carrier implicates her mom. A false positive.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: On this episode, Antinarcotics officials at Jorge Chavez International Airport in Lima, Peru, face a potentially dramatic situation: a woman is arrested trying to smuggle cocaine while traveling with her two young children. Also, the detention of an elderly man reveals that drug cartels are looking for new carrier profiles. A young woman breaks down into tears when she is detained for what is apparently illegal trafficking, while a young man who was formerly imprisoned for drug trafficking in the United Arab Emirates raises the agents' suspicions, who decide to interrogate him.At the loading docks, a typical Peruvian handicraft turns out to be the package of a pilot drug shipment, and a Chinese citizen who tried to evade security controls to traffic maca bulbs must face the consequences of his actions.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: The UK's engineering wonders revealed: including innovative electric flying machines, ingenious skyscrapers, the secrets of London's Tower Bridge, a 57 billion pound railway and a mega-stadium with a surprising historical twist.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Explore the engineering wonders of Europe's northernmost region, from Iceland's epic lava-defying barriers to Finland's record-breaking vertical factory. This spectacular journey uncovers the Nordic's boldest builds including the construction of the world's largest wooden city and a Swedish ferry that doesn't just sail—it flies.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Zalgiris Kaunas - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Magazines: ATP Tour This Week. Episode 25
Tennis: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 5
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Lagle rännakud
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm Eesti ühiskonnategelasest, kunagisest poliitvangist ja väga erilisest naisest Lagle Parekust. Tema rännak algab 1941. aastal ja jõuab välja tänapäeva. Lagle Pareki esimene reis viis teda juba lapseeas koos perega küüditatuna Siberisse ning aastakümneid hiljem poliitvangina Mordva vangilaagrisse. Nendest sündmustest hoolimata ei meenuta Lagle seda aega kui kannatuste rada, vaid pigem kui seiklust. Parek on ideaalne eeskuju mõistmaks, kuidas kõikide raskuste puhul saab jääda inimeseks. See on lugu inimese olemusest ja kirest elada. Sealjuures Lagle ei väsi kordamast oma ema tarkust: "Pole vahet, kus sa elad, peaasi, et sa inimeseks jääd".

programme.title: Ühte sulanud südamed
programme.desc: Raskustes raamatupoe pidaja Mary ja tuntud pahapoisist hokimängija Adam pannakse koos töötama, et nad kumbki teise poole kuvandit parandaksid. Peagi avastavad nad ka ise, et vastandid tõepoolest tõmbuvad.

programme.title: Nigella lihtsad road
programme.desc: Nigella jagab viimaseid hea tuju toidu retsepte: aurutatud rannakarbid Tai basiilikuga, oliiviõliga röstitud müsli, grillitud halloumi magusa tšillikastmega.

programme.title: Maailm täis luksust
programme.desc: Luksushotellid pakuvad külluslikku kogemust. Nende seas on St Lucia Jade Mountain ja hotell Metropole Monacos, kus ööbimine võib maksta lausa 200 000 naela. Londoni Lanesborough' hotell uhkustab haruldaste alkoholidega, samas kui Pariisis pakutakse vaateid endisest paleest.

programme.title: Eksid rannal - kehad vormi
programme.desc: Becci ei taha enam olla "see paks õde" ja Kieran ei taha olla "see perekonna kõige nirum". Kas nad jõuavad oma kehad enne "Eksid rannal"-stiilis paljastust ümber modelleeerida?

programme.title: Rannamaja remondihundid
programme.desc: Äge suhtesari "Rannamaja" pakub vaatajatele kuhjaga romantilisi suhteid ning pööraseid seiklusi! Kuus noort ja vallalist kolivad elama rannamajja ühe eesmärgiga – luua romantilisi suhteid ja leida omale kaaslane. Kui kokkukolinute hulgas sobivat paarilist ei ole, siis korraldatakse pidusid eesmärgiga leida kaaslane pidutsedes. Juba esimeses episoodis selgub, et osalistevahelised tunded võivad tekkida väga kiiresti ning sama kiirelt võib kogu olukord võtta ka dramaatilise pöörde.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Taylor ja Jason on stjuardess ja tuletõrjuja, kelle vahel tekib kohe hea klapp, nad on koos tänaseni. Joe otsib "head tüdrukut", aga Christine'il on liiga jõuline karakter, teist kohtingut ei tule. Kate'ile meeldib Justani "isa keha", aga Justan pole huvitatud. Breanne kohtab viimaks ometi härrasmeest, kel nimeks samuti Adam, ja noored ütlevad teineteisele "jah".

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Jason ei lakka hetkekski endast rääkimast, aga Jasmine nõustub sellegipoolest teise kohtinguga. Hollie ja Zac saavad austrite ja isanaljade üle palju naerda, aga Hollyle tundubki nende läbisaamine liiga lõõpiv, et tõsiseks minna. Jyhe ja Emma leiavad ühise keele närvilisuse ja enesekindluse teemal, mis viib armastuseni. Jutukas Steve avaldab Fionale muljet, kuid ei pea ise Fionat piisavalt lõbusaks.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Telepersoon Paula Duncan võidab Jeffi südame vaatamata sellele, et ta telefon ei lakka helisemast. Mõlemad ütlevad "jah". Scarlett ja Colby avastavad, et neid ühendab armastus kiirtoidu vastu. Amy omapärane naer mõjub atleetvõimlejast Quintinile eemaletõukavalt, ta ütleb "ei". DJ Nicole jahmatab vana kooli meest Andrew'd oma lauakommetega. Mees marsib välja, mõlema poolt tuleb kindel "ei".

programme.title: Armastuse rendileping
programme.desc: Turundusspetsialist Poppy elu pööratakse pea peale, kui ta teeskleb, et on kihlatud oma ülemuse nägusa uue kilendi Miloga, selleks et võita oma range majahalduri soosing ja et Milo saaks endale katusesviidi.

programme.title: Bella Vista saladused
programme.desc: Tess saab teada, et ta isa, keda ta polnud kunagi näinud, pärandas surres talle ja ta poolõele õunaaia. Ta sõidab mõisasse ja kohtub esimest korda elus oma poolõega. Selgub, et viljapuuaed on suurtes võlgades ja perekonnal on palju saladusi. Kas ta suudab saladused lahti harutada ja pärandvara päästa?

programme.title: Maailm täis luksust
programme.desc: Luksushotellid pakuvad külluslikku kogemust. Nende seas on St Lucia Jade Mountain ja hotell Metropole Monacos, kus ööbimine võib maksta lausa 200 000 naela. Londoni Lanesborough' hotell uhkustab haruldaste alkoholidega, samas kui Pariisis pakutakse vaateid endisest paleest.

programme.title: Väike teene
programme.desc: Paul Feigi ("Spioon", "Pruutneitsid") lavastatud "Väike teene" jutustab vlogijast Stephaniest (Anna Kendrick, "Hr Õige", "Audiitor"), kes tahab teada tõde, miks ta parim sõber Emily (Blake Lively, "Madalik", "Adaline'i aeg") järsku nende väikelinnast kadus. Stephaniele asub appi Emily abikaasa Sean (Henry Golding "Aasia hullult rikkad"). Stiilne põnevik on täis pöördeid ja reetmisi, saladusi ja paljastusi, armastust ja truudust, mõrva ja kättemaksu.

programme.title: Ma näen su häält
programme.desc: Tippklassi meelelahutus võrratu saatejuhi Piret Laose juhtimisel. Saates osaleval arvajapaaril tuleb tundmatute seast eristada imelise lauluoskusega inimesed andekatest teesklejatest, kes üldse laulda ei oska. Arvajatele on abiks nõunike kogu, kuhu kuuluvad meelelahutaja Grete Kuld, näitleja Evelin Võigemast, 5Miinuse liige Estoni Kohver ning näitleja Tõnis Niinemets. Külalisnõunikuna astub seekord üles andekas laulja Maarja-Liis Ilus.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus
programme.desc: Itaalia versioon omanäolisest kohtingusaatest, kus valik tehakse aeglaselt paljastuvate alasti kehade põhjal.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus
programme.desc: Itaalia versioon omanäolisest kohtingusaatest, kus valik tehakse aeglaselt paljastuvate alasti kehade põhjal.

programme.title: Alasti ahvatlus
programme.desc: Itaalia versioon omanäolisest kohtingusaatest, kus valik tehakse aeglaselt paljastuvate alasti kehade põhjal.

programme.title: Murtud südamete saar
programme.desc: CJ arvab, et võib oma kolme viimast naist usaldada, ent kas see on ikka nii? Caseyle meeldib Hannah väga ning Camille ja Michi kasutavad äärmuslikke meetmeid. Kõik pöördub pea peale ja Benedict jõuab murdepunkti.

programme.title: Murdochi müsteeriumid
programme.desc: Murdoch kardab, et sarimõrvari sihtmärgiks on teistest kultuuridest pärit mehed, kui väljalt leitakse lagunevad surnukehad.

programme.title: Ussikuninganna
programme.desc: Bangkok aastal 1975. Hollandi diplomaat Herman Knippenberg asub uurima noore paari kadumist, keda nähti viimati elusana kalliskivikaupleja Charles Sobhraji korteris.

programme.title: Dalgliesh
programme.desc: Dalgliesh sõidab külla oma vanale sõbrale, kuid selgub, et too on vahepeal surnud. Dalgliesh otsustab siiski nädalalõpuks üksikusse maakohta jääda ja satub veidrasse kogukonda, kus tema silme all hakkavad inimesed kahtlastel asjaoludel surema.

programme.title: Suured loomad, väiksed loomad
programme.desc: Jamesil lõpuks edeneb talunikele põllumajandusministeeriumi poolt pakutud tuberkuloori testimise skeemi ärakasutamine. Ja Tristan viib kohtingule Siegfriedi rivaali tütre, Florence Pandhi.

programme.title: Miss Marple: Laip raamatukogutoas
programme.desc: Kariibi mere saarel puhkav miss Marple kohtub major Palgrave'iga, kes teatab, et kohtas siinsamas mõrvarit. Kui nüüd major sureb, ei usu miss Marple sugugi, et surma põhjustas infarkt.

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: Miss Marple aitab noorel naisel pojaga põgeneda vägivaldse mehe eest ja peidab ta oma vana botaanikust sõbra juurde. Paraku polegi vana mõisamaja nii turvaline, sest selle kodakondsed hakkavad järjepanu surema.

programme.title: D'Urberville'ide Tess
programme.desc: Traumaatilise kohtumise järel manipuleeriva Aleciga üritab vaene maatüdruk Tess oma elu taas üles ehitada ja armub idealistlikku Angelisse. Kui tema minevik uuesti välja ilmub, katkeb nende armusuhe.

programme.title: Perekond Hardacre
programme.desc: See on vaesest rikkaks saamise lugu, mis jälgib töölisklassi kuuluva Hardacre'i perekonna elu, armusuhteid ja õnnestumisi 1890ndate Yorkshire'is.

programme.title: Perekond Forsyte
programme.desc: Forsyte & Co. tabab katastroof, mis põhjustab klientide rahalise laostumise. Soames räägib Irene'ile, et Jamesil on süda haige. Jo keeldub Louisa oma elust välja jätmast ning otsib talle suvilakoha.

programme.title: Miss Austen
programme.desc: Gill Hornby menuromaanil põhinev ajalooline draama, mis kujundab ümber kirjandusliku müsteeriumi sellest, kuidas Cassandra Austen põletab oma õe Jane'i kirjad.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Vikaar William Davenport ja kohalik inspektor Geordie Keating lahendavad 1950ndate aastate Grantchesteri külas kuritegusid. Keating läheneb asjale sirgjoonelise politseinikuna, sellal kui vikaar usaldab rohkem oma vaistu ning oskab tunnistajatelt ja kahtlusalustelt infot välja keelitada.

programme.title: Preili Scarlet ja Hertsog
programme.desc: Kui Dylan Cooper kinni peetakse, sepitsevad kaaslased plaani tema vabastamiseks; Blake ja uus uurija George Willows veedavad koos pika ja pingelise öö; Cooperi liitlased üritavad põgeneda.

programme.title: Marlow' mõrvaklubi
programme.desc: Kui purjetamisklubi liige tapetakse, peavad Judith, Becks ja Suzie õiglust taga ajades toime tulema kogukonna vihaga.

programme.title: Mõrv väikelinnas
programme.desc: Peaaegu surmaga lõppenud tulistamine jätab Jack Couttsi elu ja surma vahele kõlkuma ning ta pomiseb kaks salapärast vihjet: "Chad" ja "Monsoon". Väljaspool uurimist süveneb Albergi suhe Cassandraga.

programme.title: Tark mees taskus
programme.desc: Walsinghami hotellis nähti teise maailmasõja ajal nii üht kui teist, aga kas see tuleb toime ka mõrvaga? Võimalikel kahtlusalustel ei paista lõppu, kui mürgikokteil kapten Victor Orri hotelli baaris jalust niidab.

programme.title: Perekond Forsyte
programme.desc: Jolyon nõuab, et tal lubataks oma isakohuseid täita, samas kui James püüab teda firmast välja puksida. Soames lubab Irene'ile, et nad kolivad Pariisi, et edendada naise tantsijakarjääri, enne kui nad abielluvad.

programme.title: Dalgliesh
programme.desc: 1979. aastal toimub Lääne-Sussexi vaimulikus seminaris mõrv, mida saadetakse uurima Dalgliesh. Peagi leiab ta end vaimulike omavaheliste tülide keskelt, kus igaühel on oma saladus ja keegi pole päris see, kellena ta esineb.

programme.title: Ussikuninganna
programme.desc: Bangkok aastal 1975. Hollandi diplomaat Herman Knippenberg asub uurima noore paari kadumist, keda nähti viimati elusana kalliskivikaupleja Charles Sobhraji korteris.

programme.title: Miss Fisheri mõrvalood
programme.desc: Popstaar ja tema taustatantsija saavad telesaates trikki sooritades elektrilöögi ning Peregrine'i erapooletus pannakse proovile, kui tema vanast poiss-sõbrast Ericust saab juhtumi peamine kahtlusalune.

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: Miss Marple tutvub võluva autojuhiga, kes abiellub peagi rikka pärijannaga, ostab neetud maatüki ning laseb oma sõbral sinna muinasjutumaja ehitada. Seda kohta aga ümbritsevad tumedad legendid ja needused ning õnnetus ei lase end kaua oodata. Miss Marple'il tuleb eluga riskides paljastada tõeline süüdlane.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Lenna talu
programme.desc: Kaupmees müüb Lennale naeriste jaoks väetist. Väike põldhiir aimab oma võimalust lõpuks suureks ja tugevaks saada.

programme.title: Karumõmm Pups
programme.desc: On isadepäev ja Pups nuputab isale luuletust kirjutada.

programme.title: Numbriklotsid
programme.desc: "Numbriklotsid" on sari väikelastele, kus õpetatakse laulude ja sõnamängude toel numbreid tundma ning rehkendusi tegema. Matemaatika on tore - õpime koos liitma ja lahutama!

programme.title: Okkake ja Nõelake
programme.desc: Nõelake on selga pannud oma erilise superkangelase keebi ja mängib Supersiili, kuid kui Okkake kohale jõuab ja tema nurjunud lendamiskatset näeb, tunneb Nõelake piinlikkust ja jookseb minema. Tarkusetera - eesmärke omada on hea ja on ka hästi, kui neid soovi korral muudad!

programme.title: Hiir Hops
programme.desc: Hopsil algab vaheaeg, kuid ta ärkab hommikul enne teisi ja ajab kogu pere üles, et kõik temaga tegeleksid. Kui aga Hille järgmisel hommikul temaga samamoodi käitub, saab Hops aru, kui oluline on lasta teistel magada.

programme.title: Hiir Hops
programme.desc: Hops saab isalt kingituseks paki plastiliini, kuid keeldub seda avamast. Kas see on aga mõistlik või on plastiliini voolimisest rohkem rõõmu kui kinnisest karbist?

programme.title: Tuta asjad
programme.desc: Tuta ja Mägrake otsustavad valmistada nuku. Mõistata Tuta mõistatusi, et saada teada, milliste kehaosadeta ei saa üks nukk hakkama. Valmista endale nukk sinagi!

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Sam ja Julia
programme.desc: Sõbrad unistavad lumesajust ja murravad pead, mida küll teha, et nende soov täituks.

programme.title: Kosmo
programme.desc: Merisilma linnakese ümbruses tegutseb noortekamp, kes end Punailvesteks kutsuvad. Nad mõtlevad välja kaelamurdvaid trikke ja heiskavad oma lipu eriti ohtlikesse kohtadesse. Robi on uljaspeade tegevusest vaimustuses ja tahab nendega liituda. Kõigepealt tuleb tal läbida julguseproov, mis paneb ta elu hädaohtu. Õnneks tulevad talle appi nii Elis kui ka Kosmo ja ka Punailvesed peavad oma teod ümber hindama.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika
programme.desc: Kees võltsib oma matemaatikaeksami hinnet, Floor aga kahtlustab, et vennast ei ole siiski üleöö matemaatikageenius saanud...

programme.title: Lucas
programme.desc: Jeff näikse midagi varjavat... Lucas otsustab tema saladuse päevavalgele tirida.

programme.title: Maagiline reis Kuule
programme.desc: Saksa populaarsel lasteraamatul põhinev film räägib Peetrist, kes oma väikse õe kurja Kuumehe käest päästmiseks asub maagilisele rännakule koos härra Putuka ja Unematiga. Eesti vaatajate jaoks on filmitegelastele oma hääle andnud Mikk Jürjens (Peeter), Saara Pius (Anne), Ott Lepland (Kuumees), Erki Aule (Härra Putukas), Merilin Kirbits (Välgunõid), Maarius Pärn (Unemati), Karin Aule (Ööhaldjas) ja paljud teised. Film on dubleeritud eesti keelde dubleerimisstuudios Orbital Vox Stuudiod. Dublaažiprodutsent on Mari Randmäe, dublaaži- ja helirežissöör Andres Nõlvak. Eesti keelde tõlkinud Piret Õunapuu.

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Homme põgeneme
programme.desc: Selgub, et Rix ja Jaanus tegelevad metsas hoopis millegi muuga, kui aarde otsimisega. Manfred saab laborist vastused, mis lasevad arvata, et kirjaniku teoorial pole üldse tõepõhja all. Pettunud Manfred lahkub laagrist. Samal ajal valmistub kogu laager lõpuetenduseks. Saabuvad vanemad ja algab etendus, millel on väga ootamatu lõpp. Režissöör Kaire Russ, tootja Kassikuld OÜ.

programme.title: Delfiinmees
programme.desc: Kreeka režissööri Lefteris Charitose legendaarne dokumentaalfilm viib meid kuulsa sukelduja Jacques Mayoli maailma. Mayol püüdis terve elu jooksul leida vahetut kontakti inimeste ja delfiinide vahel. 1950.-1960. aastatel Euroopas, Indias ja Bahamas ülesvõetud kaadrid ning mitmete tuntumate sukeldujate mälestused Mayolist annavad põhjaliku ülevaate tema põnevast elukäigust.

programme.title: Route 66. Ameerika kahel pool maanteed
programme.desc: Tõotatud maa Kalifornia ei kätke endas vaid filmistaare, glamuuri ja kurgikooresmuutisid. Osariigi kaguosas haigutab hiigelsuur ja inimasustusega hõredalt kaetud Mojave kõrb koos kõige selle juurde kuuluvaga. On kõrbelinnasid, kuhu vajalik joogivesi rongiga kohale tuuakse, ning vahel peidab kõrb endas nii tõelisi ja imeväärseid pärle kui ka asju, millele ei oskagi loogilist seletust leida. Seal, kus inimesed, võetakse külaline aga alati avasüli vastu. Olgu koht siis sedavõrd segane, nagu ta parasjagu on. Produtsent Herbert Murd, režissöör Väino Laisaar. Saatejuhid Madis Aesma, Laura Prits, Artur Aukon.

programme.title: Hämmastavad hotellid
programme.desc: Monica Galetti ja Giles Coren ei pea seekord ette võtma pikka reisi - nad suunduvad Iirimaale 800 aastat vanasse lossi. Ashfordi lossi ajalugu on pikk ja kirev, vähem kui kümne aasta eest tehti sellest luksushotell. Hotell on edukas tänu pühendunud töötajatele, kellest paljud on kohalikud ja nende suguvõsad on olnud sajandeid lossiga seotud.

programme.title: Sharon Stone. Ellujäämisinstinkt
programme.desc: Ka aastakümned pärast rolli filmis "Ürginstinkt" saadab Sharon Stone'i seksika psühhopaadi kuvand. Samas on ta olnud Oscari kandidaat ja võitnud Kuldgloobuse. Lisaks näitlemisele on Sharon Stone võidelnud meeste ülemvõimu vastu ja palgavõrdsuse eest filmitööstuses, tegelnud heategevuse ning ühiskonnaaktivismiga. See on lugu näitlejatarist, kes vaatamata eluraskustele on suutnud Hollywoodi tippude seas püsida üle 40 aasta.

programme.title: Hispaania suudlus
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm 2023. aastal Hispaaniat raputanud skandaalist, kus riigi Jalgpalliliidu president Luis Rubiales suudles naiskoondise mängijat ilma tolle loata. Rubialesi esialgne otsus ametis jätkata vallandas suure pahameeletormi, millest kasvas välja üleriigiline liikumine eesmärgiga panna punkt Hispaanias vohavale seksismile ja olukorrale, kus ahistajad võivad karistust kartmata tegutseda.

programme.title: Puu, mis varjutab metsa
programme.desc: Kanada läänerannikul Great Beari vihmametsas kohtuvad kaks vastandlikku universumi - ookean ja mets. Vastastikuse sõltuvuse keerulistes suhetes panevad lõhe ja merekarbid puid kasvama, mis omakorda, hukkudes või lehti langetades, toidavad ookeani. Maa ja mere vahel kõrgub kuuskede kohal taeva poole hiigel-elupuu, mille kaudu nuxalki põlisrahvas suhtleb esivanemate vaimudega. Hiigel-elupuu on koduks lõpmata paljudele liikidele. Tuhandeaastased juured hoiavad seda maailmas ainulaadse ökosüsteemi vahipuud kindlalt püsti.

programme.title: Puu, mis varjutab metsa
programme.desc: Madagaskari kuivas metsas on igal baobabil oma lugu ja igal lool oma baobab. Need majesteetlikud puud on Madagaskari elanike vaikivad valvurid. Sakalava hõimudele valvavad baobabid väärtuslikku ressurssi - vett. Puu suudab ladustada kuni 120 000 liitrit vett, elades samal ajal harmoonias ümbritseva keskkonnaga. Baobabid on bioloogilise mitmekesisuse varjupaik, ent need sajandite vanused puud on nüüd vaid kaduvate metsade fossiilid, mida tänapäeval ohustab globaalne soojenemine. Puu sõltub nüüd inimestest, kes peavad tegutsema, et taastada habras bioloogiline mitmekesisus.

programme.title: Vau! Teade kosmosest
programme.desc: 11-aastased Annabell ja Dino on täiesti veendunud, et nendega proovivad ühendust võtta tulnukad. Keegi ei usu neid! Kosmosekeskust külastades lendavad lapsed kogemata raketiga kosmosesse, kus nad siis maavälist elu otsima hakkavad - algab uskumatu seiklus.

programme.title: Homme põgeneme
programme.desc: Selgub, et Rix ja Jaanus tegelevad metsas hoopis millegi muuga, kui aarde otsimisega. Manfred saab laborist vastused, mis lasevad arvata, et kirjaniku teoorial pole üldse tõepõhja all. Pettunud Manfred lahkub laagrist. Samal ajal valmistub kogu laager lõpuetenduseks. Saabuvad vanemad ja algab etendus, millel on väga ootamatu lõpp. Režissöör Kaire Russ, tootja Kassikuld OÜ.

programme.title: Kosmo
programme.desc: Merisilma linnakese ümbruses tegutseb noortekamp, kes end Punailvesteks kutsuvad. Nad mõtlevad välja kaelamurdvaid trikke ja heiskavad oma lipu eriti ohtlikesse kohtadesse. Robi on uljaspeade tegevusest vaimustuses ja tahab nendega liituda. Kõigepealt tuleb tal läbida julguseproov, mis paneb ta elu hädaohtu. Õnneks tulevad talle appi nii Elis kui ka Kosmo ja ka Punailvesed peavad oma teod ümber hindama.

programme.title: FIFA jalgpalli MM. Kanada - Maroko
programme.desc: Jalgpalli MM-võistluste finaalturniiri korraldavad sel suvel ühiselt Mehhiko, Kanada ja USA. Turniir kestab üle viie nädala ning esmakordselt osalevad finaalturniiril koguni 48 meeskonda, peetakse 104 kohtumist. Maailmameister selgub juuli keskpaigas.

programme.title: Tom Hanks. Nomaad
programme.desc: Teledokumentaal näitleja Tom Hanksist, kelle vaoshoitud kannatlikkus oodata ära oma aeg on toonud talle Oscareid ja unistuste rolle. Tundmatust noorest mehest, kes rahutu nomaadi kombel koole vahetas ja teatrinäitlejana ühest linnast teise reisis, sai ühtäkki särav täht, keda teadis kogu maailm. Menukiks tõusnud "Olla suur" (1988) tegi temast noorte lemmiku, AIDSi-draama "Philadelphia" (1993) tõi talle esimese Oscari ja "Forrest Gump" (1994) tõusis juba iidoli staatusse. R: Jake Hickman. O: Tim Allen, Tom Arnold, Kevin Bacon. 9. juulil on Tom Hanksi 70. sünnipäev.

programme.title: Killud
programme.desc: Arhitekt Mihkel Tüür töötab selleks, et inimesed talveks võimalikult toredatesse riiulitesse paigutada. Kus on arhitektuuri lagi ja põrand ning millised väikesed vead teevad lihtsatest ehitistest hingestatud hooned?

programme.title: 21. sajandi bluus
programme.desc: Siim Aimla, üks eesti jazzmaastiku tuntumaid muusikuid, tähistas Jõulujazzi raames suure kontserdiga oma 50-aastast juubelit. Kontserdil kõlas pühendunud saksofonist-multiinstrumentalisti, helilooja ja nõutud bändijuhi verivärske teos "21. sajandi bluus", mille on Aimla enda sõnul loonud oma unistuste bigbandile.

programme.title: Psühho
programme.desc: "Vaesusega on see paha lugu, et see võtab kogu sinu aja" - sellisele järeldusele on jõudnud paljud mõtlejad. Igapäevaelu tiirleb tihti ümber viletsa ja ebameeldiva. On see möödapääsmatu ja paratamatu ning mis on selle põhjus ja tagajärg? Saatejuht Märt Treieri külalised on kultuuriloolane Linnar Priimägi, kirjanik Valdur Mikita, psühhiaater Andres Lehtmets, ajakirjanik ja loovterapeut Kadi Jaanisoo-Kuld, kirjanik Pamela Maran, kohtutäitur Risto Sepp.

programme.title: Ukuaru
programme.desc: Leida Laiuse mängufilm Veera Saare samanimelise romaani ainetel. Töölisneiu Minna valib rikka kosilase asemel pillimees Aksli, kelle ainus vara on lõõts ja armastus Minna vastu. Kehvad olud ja raske töö ei tumesta noore naise elurõõmu ega murra tema meelekindlust. Talle on tähtis rajada oma kodu, kus jookseksid lapsed ja mängiks lõõts. Armastus saadab kauges metsatalus korda imesid, kuid ühte ta ei suuda - hoida suure maailma hullust ohutus kauguses. Peaosades Elle Kull ja Lembit Ulfsak. Stsenarist Mats Traat, operaator Jüri Garšnek, helilooja Arvo Pärt.

programme.title: Sajandi armastus
programme.desc: Ukraina külast röövitud kaunitar Alexandra on otsustanud pigem surra kui leppida eesootava orjapõlvega Türgi sultani haaremis. Ta pere on tapetud ja tal ei ole enam midagi kaotada. Nii võitleb ta kogu jõust vangistuse ja kõige sellega kaasneva vastu.

programme.title: Kirgede kaevandus
programme.desc: Põnev Mehhiko sari sukeldab vaatajad intriigide, armastuse ja õigluse eest võitlemise maailma. Süžee keerleb Emilia Sanchezi (Livia Brito) ümber, noore ja sihikindla naise ümber, kes naaseb oma kodulinna, et teada saada tõde oma isa salapärase surma kohta. Ta kohtub võimsa Santa Maria perekonnaga, kes kontrollib kohalikke kaevandusi ja varjab palju saladusi.

programme.title: Pime armastus
programme.desc: Lucrecia abiga õnnestub Isaurol DNA tulemused enda kasuks pöörata ja kohtunik kinnitab, et Rafael on tema poeg. Marina on šokeeritud, kui saab teada, et ta peab Rafa hooldusõigust jagama.

programme.title: Power Hit Radio
programme.desc: Power Hit Radio - NON. STOP. MUSIC.

programme.title: Varjudemaa
programme.desc: Rita seisab nüüd vastamisi kogu küla raevuga. Samal ajal tuleb ajada kadunud tüdruku jälgi, kellel võib olla isa surma kohta olulist infot. Õdede suhe on muutunud jäiseks, Rita keeldub isa talu müügis osalemast ja lubab tehingut takistada, kuni asjad pole selged. Rita saab ootamatult teada, et isa surmaga lõpenud hämar lugu võib olla veelgi jubedam ja ulatuda minevikku. Külast on varemgi tüdrukuid kaduma läinud.

programme.title: Varjudemaa
programme.desc: Tallinnas edukalt karjääri teinud Rita peab naasma Saaremaale, kus ootamatult suri tema isa. Rita ei ole 20 aastat kodukülas käinud. Teda ootavad seal umbusklikud kohalikud, tumedad minevikuvarjud ja jahmatav tõdemus, et isa surm võis olla mõrv. Rita otsustab asja uurima hakata ja see seab ta silmitsi seni tundmatu pettuse, vägivalla ja hirmuga.

programme.title: Varjudemaa
programme.desc: Rita kontrollib vihjet, mis heidab üllatuslikult kahtlusevarju hoopis tema õemehele. Rita õde ähvardab nüüd aga Rita jõuga talust välja tõsta, et saaks talu müügitehingu lõpule viia. Keegi annab Ritale vihje, kust leida kunagi kadunud tüdruku sõbranna, kellel võib olla infot orgiatel osalenud ja siis kadunud tüdrukute kohta. Uurimisretk viib Rita tõelisse hullumajja. Rita leiab lõpuks tunnistaja, keda ta nii meeletult taga on otsinud ja külakeses hakkab jällegi verd voolama.
